report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: gateway checkout span OK at 67ms, error_rate 0.0014, p95 79ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs across services. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, and healthy signals contradict the degraded-health alert. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handing off for human review.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate or p95 latency) to confirm the alert; current metrics show error_rate 0.0014 and p95 79ms.
Per-service latency/error breakdown across gateway, order, payment, inventory to localize any fault.
Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiter data over a longer window to test db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency.
Memory retention time series per service to evaluate memory-leak.
Deployment records and config change history to test bad-configuration.
